name: cloud-text-to-speech-examples
description: Examples for Cloud Text-to-Speech Universal Interface
author: Marko Kostich

scripts.copy-env: cp .env-example .env 2>/dev/null || echo 'Please copy .env.example to .env and configure your API keys'
scripts.basic:all: npm run basic:amazon && npm run basic:google && npm run basic:microsoft
scripts.universal:all: npm run universal:start && npm run universal:multi && npm run universal:ssml && npm run universal:errors
scripts.advanced:all: npm run advanced:amazon && npm run advanced:google && npm run advanced:microsoft
scripts.clean: rm -f src/basic/*.mp3 src/basic/*.wav src/universal/*.mp3 src/universal/*.wav src/advanced/*.mp3 src/advanced/*.wav
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:build
scripts.validate-env: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const required=['GOOGLE_API_KEY','MICROSOFT_TTS_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY','AMAZON_TTS_KEY_ID']; const missing=required.filter(k=>!process.env[k]); if(missing.length) { console.log('Missing:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } console.log('✅ Environment validated');"
